validation.notes: This is the site logo of isd.pku.edu.cn, the International Students Division (Office of International Relations) of Peking University - the office that publishes and administers the Chinese Government Scholarship for the Advanced Graduate Program at PKU, i.e. the awarding body named in the record. It is rendered as the header logo of the record's own official_source_url, so it is the highest-tier source available (official scholarship/programme page). Downloaded and visually inspected: 510x59 px PNG showing the circular Peking University seal (Lu Xun 'Beida' mark, '1898') + the '北京大学 / PEKING UNIVERSITY' wordmark + '国际学生办公室 / International Students Division, Office of International Relations'. GET verified 200, image/png, 7818 bytes. MEDIUM, not HIGH, for two reasons: (a) the asset is a 510x59 header lockup, i.e. a small rather than a full-resolution brand file; (b) it is a composite lockup that names the division as well as the university, so it is a provider identity rather than the bare university seal. Peking University's official visual-identity downloads (https://vim.pku.edu.cn/xzzq/index.htm) are distributed only as .zip/.rar/.eps/.doc archives (e.g. '标志(圆形校徽).zip', '标志与英文校名组合规范.eps'), so no direct image URL exists there; the official VI manual PDF https://www.pku.edu.cn/Uploads/Picture/2019/12/04/u5de7ad0c17491.pdf (verified 200 application/pdf) is a document, not an image asset.

validation.notes: Tilburg University renders its logo as an inline <use> reference into the icon sprite /themes/custom/tiu/assets/svg/dist.svg#tiu-logo, which is a spritesheet and therefore rejected. The same theme also serves the identical artwork as a standalone file at /themes/custom/tiu/logo.svg. Identity was proven geometrically, not by filename: the standalone file is a single self-contained graphic (zero <symbol> elements, viewBox="0 0 220 56", aspect 3.93:1) and its first path begins 'M108.408077,38.7758841 C108.460385,38.7697533 C108.531923,38.7390991 ...', which is exactly the sprite symbol's first path 'M108.408 38.776c.052-.006.124-.037.173 0 ...' re-expressed with higher precision (the relative deltas reconcile to 5 decimal places), and the sprite symbol carries viewBox="0 0 220 56" with fills #036 (corporate blue) and #C93 (red), the colours of the tree/book/key crest described on Tilburg's own 'Logo Tilburg University' heritage page. GET verified 200, image/svg+xml, 145502 bytes. MEDIUM rather than HIGH because: (a) the official brand-asset download links that Tilburg's own site publishes point to a SharePoint forms library (tilburgu.sharepoint.com, .../Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=...Logo/Kleur/Beeldscherm) and to the staff intranet /intranet/support/communication/visual-identity-and-design - neither is a direct fetchable asset, and both are behind auth; (b) the asset is vector only (no official raster variant exists on the domain - logo.png/logo.jpg all 404). No raster Umny variant could be proven on the official domain.
